description: Everything about one project before acting on it: Strapi version (installed / declared), TypeScript or JavaScript, package manager, API prefix, counts (APIs, content-types by kind, components, services, controllers, policies, middlewares, routes), every local and installed plugin with whether DevKit verifies refs into it and, if not, why (no node_modules, rewritten at boot by a project file, a src/extensions override, Enterprise-only code…), health (broken refs, refs into unverified plugins) and freshness. Call it to orient yourself in an unknown project, or when a plugin ref comes back `external`.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

name: project_info
title: Describe one Strapi project (and why a plugin ref may be unverified)
